title: VRLLM: Turning LLMs into Powerful Tabular Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2611.22308v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on text, but whether pretrained LLMs are effective for large-scale tabular classification remains unclear, as many previous works demonstrate that LLMs' tabular data classification performance falls behind tree-based models or neural architectures designed for tabular data. At Visa Research, we managed to fine-tune a pretrained Llama 3.2 1B LLM on billions of rows of labeled tabular data and make it outperform a wide array of tabular classifiers and even our competitive production deep learning model. For ease of reference, we refer to the model as the Visa Research LLM (VRLLM). In this paper, we share how we achieved this exciting result, covering data preparation, training recipe, ablation studies of design choices and deployment validation. translated_title: VRLLM：将大语言模型转化为强大的表格分类器
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在文本任务上已展现出强大性能，但预训练LLM是否能有效用于大规模表格分类仍不明确，因为许多先前的研究表明，LLM在表格数据分类上的表现落后于基于树的模型或专为表格数据设计的神经架构。在Visa Research，我们成功地在数十亿行带标签的表格数据上微调了预训练的Llama 3.2 1B大语言模型，使其超越了众多表格分类器，甚至超越了我们具有竞争力的生产级深度学习模型。为便于参考，我们将该模型称为Visa Research LLM（VRLLM）。在本文中，我们分享了实现这一令人振奋的成果的方法，涵盖数据准备、训练方案、设计选择的消融研究以及部署验证。我们还在同一任务上对前沿LLM进行了基准测试，并分析了不同模型家族和世代之间的预测行为差异。
tldr: Visa Research通过在数十亿行带标签表格数据上微调Llama 3.2 1B模型（VRLLM），首次证明LLM在大规模表格分类任务上可以超越传统表格分类器以及生产级深度学习模型。
en_tdlr: Visa Research fine-tuned a pretrained Llama 3.2 1B model (VRLLM) on billions of rows of labeled tabular data, showing for the first time that an LLM can outperform a wide range of tabular classifiers and even their competitive production deep learning model on large-scale tabular classification.
